precondition_review.condition: AreKRM validates that input resources are KRM; runPipeline calls it only when the pipeline is empty, so it is not on the configPath exclusion path.
precondition_review.rationale: AreKRM is invoked in the pl.IsEmpty() branch, which returns before runMutators/runValidators; the planned changes do not alter that branch.

precondition_review.condition: MergeWithInput merges transformed output with input by kpt-resource-id annotation; the selector/exclusion mutator branch relies on it to retain unselected resources.
precondition_review.rationale: CHG-1 keeps MergeWithInput with the full input in the selector/exclusion branch so the omitted configPath resource, being unselected, is retained; PC-1 and preservation checks cover this.

precondition_review.condition: SetResourceIDs annotates each input resource with kpt-resource-id before mutation when selectors or exclusions are present.
precondition_review.rationale: CHG-1 preserves the existing SetResourceIDs call on the full input before selection; PRES-ANNOT covers annotation cleanup and PC-1 covers selector-mode exclusion.

precondition_review.condition: DeleteResourceIDs removes kpt-resource-id annotations after merge in the selector/exclusion branch.
precondition_review.rationale: CHG-1 preserves the existing DeleteResourceIDs call after MergeWithInput; PRES-ANNOT covers annotation cleanup.

precondition_review.condition: SelectInput returns input unchanged when no selectors, applies selectors, then applies exclusions; the planned changes pass an ordinary-input slice with the configPath resource omitted.
precondition_review.rationale: CHG-1 and CHG-2 change the slice passed to SelectInput; PC-1/PC-2 cover end-to-end exclusion, and OPEN-2 records that the configPath lookup itself is not directly probed.

precondition_review.condition: errors.E wraps errors with op/path/name; runPipeline uses it to wrap runMutators/runValidators errors.
precondition_review.rationale: The planned changes preserve existing error returns and do not alter error wrapping in runPipeline.

precondition_review.condition: Pkg.Pipeline returns the Kptfile pipeline; runMutators/runValidators read pl.Mutators/pl.Validators and their ConfigPath fields.
precondition_review.rationale: CHG-1/CHG-2 read ConfigPath from the pipeline entries returned by Pipeline(); PC-1/PC-2 cover the resulting exclusion behavior.

precondition_review.condition: ValidatePipeline checks that each non-empty ConfigPath corresponds to a resource path in the package; runPipeline calls it before runMutators.
precondition_review.rationale: ValidatePipeline establishes that a configPath resource exists in the package; CHG-1/CHG-2 rely on the same file-annotation path match, and OPEN-2 records that the lookup itself is not directly probed.

repair_mechanism: Keep full input and filtered ordinary input distinct; preserve selected/excluded branch identity merge; retain omitted config separately and append only in no-selector writeback, without introducing a new helper call whose ID prerequisite would need widening.
scope: One already-exposed fixed development candidate; not a causal ablation or whole-benchmark claim
